# Database write-guard coverage

<!-- Generated by `pnpm --filter @jags/rls-tests test:coverage -- --write`. Do not edit by hand; coverage.test.ts fails when it is stale. -->

Every database write guard in `supabase/migrations` from `20261015S40001` onward, and the live test that proves it. A guard that is added without an entry in `src/guard-registry.ts` fails `pnpm test:coverage` (offline, no database needed).

**92 guards**: 44 covered by the new write suite (`src/write-guards.test.ts`, wrong-role refused + right-role allowed), 12 covered by the older suites, 7 bookkeeping triggers that refuse nothing, **29 gaps** (listed below with the reason).

The live suites WRITE to a real Supabase project and are never part of the default `pnpm test`; see `src/gate.ts` for the two flags they need.
